# Giorgi Khvichia

> The portfolio of Giorgi Khvichia, a full-stack software engineer in Tbilisi, Georgia. He builds whole products: web platforms, 3D experiences, AI tools and hardware. Founder of shemoqmedi.space.

## This site

- [Portfolio](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/): one page with his skills and stack, the sites he has built, a few photos, and how to reach him
- [CV, English (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV.pdf): experience, projects, education, awards and technical skills
- [CV, Georgian (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV-KA.pdf): the same CV in Georgian

## Work

- [shemoqmedi.space](https://www.shemoqmedi.space/): web design awards
- [The Room by Kencho Group](https://room.kenchogroup.ge/): a 3D furniture room
